    Fixed-effect sequential PERMANOVA

    permanova_fixed.Rd

    Initial clean-room multi-factor engine. It implements Type-I/sequential sums of squares and tests each term over the final residual mean square. Permutations are unrestricted raw-data permutations represented by the same row-and-column permutation of the Gower-centred matrix.

    permanova_fixed(
  distance,
  formula,
  data,
  permutations = 999L,
  seed = NULL,
  keep_permutations = FALSE,
  tol = 1e-10
)

    Arguments

    distance

    A `dist` object or full distance matrix.

    formula

    One-sided or two-sided model formula; the response is ignored.

    data

    Model data in the same row order as the distance matrix.

    permutations

    Number of random raw-data permutations.

    seed

    Optional random seed.

    keep_permutations

    Retain the matrix of permutation pseudo-F values.

    tol

    QR tolerance.

    Value

    An object of class `permanova_fixed`.

    Details

    This is not yet a replacement for the legacy program's EMS denominator logic for mixed, random, or nested designs.
